name: Arugula
description: Find offers that fit what you want, ranked by fit only, with links to buy from the merchant. Tell your assistant what you want in your own words; Arugula returns the offers that fit, best first, each with its price, the shop and a tracked link. Arugula may earn a commission if you buy through these links, at no extra cost to you. By using Arugula you agree to arugulanet.com/terms. Privacy: arugulanet.com/privacy.
author: Epyphite

tools.name: find_offers
tools.description: Turns the user's request, with any context they stated (location, dates, budget, party size, preferences), into an intent and returns the offers that fit, best first, each with a tracked link to show the user (tracked_url). Matching runs in the background; when no offers are back yet, call get_offers with the intent_id in a few seconds. It never buys anything. By using Arugula you agree to arugulanet.com/terms. Privacy: arugulanet.com/privacy.

brief.description: true for a short answer: each offer's title, price, fit, how to buy and tracked link, without the explanations.

dates.description: When: dates or times the user gave, for example 'before 9am tomorrow'.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag of the text, for example en-SG.

preferences.description: Anything else the user prefers, in their words.

text.description: What the user wants, in their own words, including where if it matters.

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: The offers ranked for an intent from find_offers, best first, only those that fit, each with its tracked link (tracked_url) and how_to_buy. offer_id is the offer's public ID: lst_ for a merchant listing (open tracked_url to book with the merchant, no sign-in), off_ for a seller's offer on Arugula. By using Arugula you agree to arugulanet.com/terms. Privacy: arugulanet.com/privacy.

brief.description: true for a short answer: each offer's title, price, fit, how to buy and tracked link, without the explanations.

tools.name: explain_match
tools.description: One match with its explanation: why the offer fits the request, its fit and verification, and the draft terms (getMatch). brief: true leaves the explanation out. By using Arugula you agree to arugulanet.com/terms. Privacy: arugulanet.com/privacy.

brief.description: true for a short answer: each offer's title, price, fit, how to buy and tracked link, without the explanations.
